verdict.rationale: Sandbox isolation is a fair question for an AI evaluation and observability platform, but the evidence never documents a sandbox, staging, or isolated test environment kept separate from production data. Experiments run on well-defined inputs, sample datasets, and synthetic or development data. These are evaluation features, adjacent to the story rather than an isolated sandbox, and are not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
